mapper.insert: INSERT INTO article (title, content, summary, user_id, category_id, view_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{viewCount, jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE article SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
